NdsForge.NET — Nintendo DS/DSi image toolkit

Usage: ndsforge <command> [options]

Commands:
  inspect <image.nds>                  Show structured image information
  validate <image.nds>                 Validate checksums, ranges, and references
  list <image.nds> [--long]            List named NitroFS files
  extract <image.nds> <dir> [--overwrite]
                                       Safely export all image components
  replace <image.nds> <path> <file> <output.nds> [--overwrite]
                                       Replace one NitroFS file and verify output
  manifest <image.nds> [output.json]   Emit a strict SHA-256 image manifest
  resize <input.nds> <output.nds> <preserve|trim|pad|exact> [options]
                                       Resize without moving content or changing headers
  unpack <image.nds> <new-directory>    Export a self-contained image workspace
  pack <workspace> <output.nds> [--overwrite]
                                       Verify unchanged inputs and pack byte-exactly
  build <workspace> <output.nds> [options]
                                       Rebuild payload edits with explicit sizing and authentication policy
  diff <left.nds> <right.nds>          Compare content, identities, and layout

Usage: ndsforge build <workspace-directory> <output.nds> [--capacity <bytes>] [--pad] [--padding-byte <HH>] [--ds-integrity <preserve|clear> | --dsi-integrity <clear|homebrew>] [--overwrite]
Capacity must be a power of two from 128 KiB through 4 GiB (decimal or 0x-prefixed hex). DSi builds require an explicit integrity choice.
